hints.title: Token Extraction
hints.text: Split each word on occurrences of the specified separator character.

hints.title: Empty Token Filtering
hints.text: Consecutive or outer separators produce empty tokens that must be discarded.

hints.title: List Accumulation
hints.text: Append all non-empty tokens in their original order across the input words.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: L: total characters across all words
complexity.notes: Linear scan tokenizing words on the separator character and discarding empty tokens.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Regex-based splitting can be fragile if the separator is a regex metacharacter like a dot or dollar sign.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(total characters) time and O(total characters) auxiliary space for the output list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle edge cases like leading, trailing, or adjacent separators without adding blank strings.
